category: web server / reverse proxy (Go) with automatic HTTPS; extended with xcaddy plugins
notes: Caddy 2 built with xcaddy: caddy-ratelimit, caddy-l4 (TCP/UDP/SNI passthrough), caddy-jwt, caddy-brotli and the Souin cache-handler (Caddy has no built-in cache). Automatic HTTPS stays on for acme.lab only (Pebble issuer, HTTP-01 on :80); every other site carries explicit certificates because Caddy would otherwise try to get Let's Encrypt certs for *.lab. h1/h2/h2c/h3 are enabled on the plain and TLS listeners; PROXY protocol is accepted on :8082 through a listener wrapper.

unsupported.lb_mirror: no request mirroring / shadowing in reverse_proxy
unsupported.connection_limit: no per-client concurrency limit (caddy-ratelimit is a request-rate limiter only)
unsupported.fault_injection: no fault-injection primitive (a CEL matcher cannot draw random numbers); needs a plugin
unsupported.docker_label_discovery: caddy-docker-proxy (lucaslorentz) is a separate distribution that generates the Caddyfile from labels
